description: Repo-scale: deactivating a user (new PATCH /users/{id}) must block them as a task assignee (both on create and reassignment) AND as a new project owner - 3 call sites
prompts: Add `PATCH /users/{id}` (new `UserUpdateRequest` record, currently just `Boolean active`) so a user can be deactivated. Once a user is inactive, they must be rejected everywhere they could be attached to new work - this spans three separate call sites: (1) `POST /tasks` when `assigneeId` targets them, (2) `PATCH /tasks/{id}` when `assigneeId` is changed to them, and (3) `POST /projects` when `ownerId` targets them. All three must reject with a 400 Bad Request if the referenced user exists and is inactive; a nonexistent user id should not be treated specially here (leave that to existing 404 behavior elsewhere). Add a `BadRequestException` (400) alongside the existing `NotFoundException`, wired into `ApiExceptionHandler`.
name: add_springboot_tasktracker_inactive_user_cascade
